tasks.final_text: The men's singles was a tennis event held as part of the tennis program at the 1904 Summer Olympics. It was the third time the event was held at the Olympics. There were 27 competitors from 2 nations. The event was won by Beals Wright, with the Americans sweeping the medals.

Philosopher David Chalmers believes that, while AI systems (LLMs) are not currently conscious, something he calls LLM+ may in the future be -- perhaps 10 years down the line. In evaluating the consciousness of LLMs, we prescribe a number of theories of consciousness onto them, but these theories appear to be human-centric, causing them to fail to capture the qualia of such systems.
